scope: local-only asset identity and storage path binding

change.implementation: scripts/backup.mjs derives the expected storage key from SHA-256(projectId)/SHA-256(assetId).bin and requires an exact match
change.boundary: backup creation and restore reject canonical-looking asset paths that are not bound to the stored asset identity before atomic promotion
change.negativeFixture: a synthetic asset database row and matching local file moved to a different canonical two-segment hash path

limitations: Identity binding detects metadata-to-path drift but does not cryptographically authenticate the backup package.
Independent review, off-host retention, staging drills and production rollback remain separately gated.
